text:
Jordan: Heads-up — AstraHealth marketplace go-live is scheduled TOMORROW 1600 PT. Partner told us they pushed the signed image but we still need cert rotation and final network egress checks. @Priya can you confirm the runbook status? :alarm_clock:

Priya: checking runbook now. I have the checklist but missing the image digest confirmation from marketplace. partner claim is v2.1-signed. @Max did you pull the image?

Max: pulled it a few mins ago and ran a quick smoke. Container starts but the service fails healthcheck on startup — env mismatch for REDWOOD_SERVICE_URL. stacktrace: `Error: missing REDWOOD_SERVICE_URL`

Elena: that's the env var we inject in Dedicated -> marketplace bridge. Did the marketplace image include the new config template? they were supposed to.

Carlos: I'll validate egress ports to their artifact registry: outbound 443 to artifacts.marketplace.aws / 52.23.11.0/24. Also confirming cert chain for marketplace signing endpoint.

Priya: notes from runbook step 3 (image validation):
```
# preflight
rcli image verify --image astrahealth/rvw:v2.1-signed --signature marketplace-sig --output json
rcli deploy --dry-run --env prod --image astrahealth/rvw:v2.1-signed
```
Result so far: verify OK, dry-run shows env template mismatch.

Max: quick workaround — we can inject the legacy env var mapping by adding this overlay (will patch only for go-live):
```
overlays/marketplace-legacy.yaml
REDWOOD_SERVICE_URL: https://svc.redwood.internal
REDWOOD_FEATURE_FLAGS: "marketplace_compat"
```
But we need approval from Partnerships/Customer for temporary mapping.

Jordan: acceptable as a short-lived mitigation if we gate with a canary and monitor token usage. Can we do a 5% canary for 30m and rollback automatically?

deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary=5% duration=30m rollback_on_errors=true (job id: cb-1749998888-1) :robot_face:

Priya: approved the temporary overlay for go-live only. I've updated runbook step 3 with the overlay and added a rollback trigger at step 7.

Carlos: cert chain looks good except the marketplace signer rotates intermediate cert on the 3rd of the month. Partner said rotation happened today; I requested their new CA bundle. Blocking until they share the bundle or we pin the previous chain.

Elena: action items — (1) Partner: send CA bundle (Carlos) (2) Max: prepare overlay and canary config (3) Priya: update runbook + postmortem template (4) Jordan: coordinate comms for go/no-go at +2h.

Max: I pushed the overlay to staging and validated canary workflow against staging registry. Command I ran: `rcli rollout start --canary 5 --image astrahealth/rvw:v2.1-signed --overlay overlays/marketplace-legacy.yaml` — logs look clean.

Jordan: solid. @Carlos flag if partner doesn't supply CA bundle within next 90 minutes. If that happens we abort go-live and notify customer success.

Carlos: noted. pinging partner now (cc: @Elena).

Jordan: thanks team — I'll hold the go/no-go at 1400 PT and post final in this thread. :thumbsup:
